verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Mangopay supports payouts from wallets to external bank accounts and routes them over domestic rails. It does not document per-seller payout schedules (daily, weekly, monthly or manual) or instant payouts to cards or real-time rails. The monthly fee wiring applies to the platform's own fees, and the Mirakl automation is a connector-specific claim, so neither counts as configurable seller payout scheduling.

support.subject: As an ops user, payouts run on the schedule each seller needs — daily, weekly, monthly, or manual, plus instant payouts to cards or real-time rails where supported, configurable per seller
